title: ARMS Part B Assembly
author: Laetitia Plaisance
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qisduee

steps.title: Gather materials
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: 1 × PVC base plate (45 cm × 35 cm × 1.27 cm); 9 × PVC layer plates (22.5 cm × 22.5 cm × 0.63 cm); 4 × PVC long cross spacers (30 cm × 2 cm × 1.27 cm); 8 × PVC short cross spacers (14 cm × 2 cm × 1.27 cm); 4 × 7½‑ or 8‑inch stainless‑steel bolts (minimum 2 in thread length); 16 × ½‑inch long nylon spacers; 12 × ¼‑inch stainless‑steel washers; 4 × ¼‑inch stainless‑steel nuts; 4 × ¼‑inch stainless‑steel nylon‑insert locknuts; 2 × 7/16‑inch (11 mm) wrenches; silicon grease (Aqualube/Aquashield™).

steps.title: Insert bolts with washers
steps.instruction: Place a ¼‑inch stainless‑steel washer on each of the four stainless‑steel bolts, then run the four bolts (with washers) through the four corners of a single‑layer PVC plate (22.5 cm × 22.5 cm × 0.63 cm). Invert the plate so the bolt heads and washers are underneath and the bolt shanks protrude upward.

steps.title: Add nylon spacers and second plate
steps.instruction: Slide a ½‑inch long nylon spacer onto each protruding bolt, then place a second PVC layer plate on top of the spacers, creating an open layer (this will become the top layer after inversion).

steps.title: Insert cross spacers and third plate
steps.instruction: Slide a long PVC cross spacer (30 cm × 2 cm × 1.27 cm) onto two opposite bolts. On the remaining two bolts, place one short PVC cross spacer (14 cm × 2 cm × 1.27 cm) each, oriented perpendicular to the long spacer so they contact it at right angles. Add a third PVC layer plate on top, forming a closed layer.

steps.title: Repeat layering to achieve eight plates
steps.instruction: Repeat the sequence of steps 3 (open layer) and 4 (closed layer) alternately until a total of eight PVC plates have been stacked: four open layers and four closed layers, ending with a closed layer as the fourth closed layer.

steps.title: Apply grease and secure nuts
steps.instruction: Apply silicon grease (Aqualube/Aquashield™) to the threads of all four bolts, then place a ¼‑inch stainless‑steel washer and a ¼‑inch stainless‑steel nut onto each bolt; tighten each nut securely.

steps.title: Attach base plate and lock nuts
steps.instruction: Place the PVC base plate (45 cm × 35 cm × 1.27 cm) onto the bolts with its counter‑sunk side down. If needed, re‑coat the bolt tips with silicon grease. Add a ¼‑inch washer and a ¼‑inch nylon‑insert locknut onto each bolt, then tighten securely using the two 7/16‑inch (11 mm) wrenches—one wrench holds the bolt while the other tightens the locknut.

steps.title: Invert assembly and verify alignment
steps.instruction: Invert the entire ARMS structure so that the base plate is now at the bottom. Verify that the layer directly above the base plate is a closed layer, that there is no gap between the base plate and plate #1 (the plate in contact with the base plate). The assembly is now complete.
